new_learnings.text: US semiconductor 3-sigma crash (SOX -10.3%) → A-share tech sectors follow with 1-4 day lag → defensive rotation to resources. Pattern: money exits AI/semiconductor/optics and enters coal/oil/agriculture. This should be formalized into a macro-regime detection rule.
new_learnings.mechanism: US rate expectations shock via nonfarm payrolls → global re-rating of growth/tech → A-share institutional money rotates defensively. The SOX crash magnitude (-10.3%) is a 3-sigma event that overwhelms any individual stock catalyst.

new_learnings.text: Stop proximity rule validated again: 兴森科技 at 1.71% from stop in 0.28:1 breadth tape = proactive sell is correct. The 扬杰科技 W10 precedent (1.8% → gapped to -8.37%) shows gap risk is real when breadth is this bad.
new_learnings.mechanism: In weak breadth, buyers disappear and sellers dominate the close. A stock within 2% of stop at open can gap through it before any liquidity emerges. Proactive exit preserves capital for re-entry when conditions improve.

new_learnings.text: Relative strength in weak tape is the best signal: 上海新阳 (+0.75%) and 路维光电 (+2.60%) both green while 75% of market red. This confirms their sector leadership and institutional support. Same pattern as [h028] — today's relative leaders are more likely to be tomorrow's absolute leaders when tape recovers.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks that hold green in a 0.28:1 breadth day have genuine buying demand, not just passive drift. When market recovers, these are the first stocks institutions add to.

new_learnings.text: Sector-first framework catches rotation immediately: 0/4 positions in today's hot sectors. If resource/cyclical rotation persists 3+ days, Rule 1 triggers across all positions regardless of individual stock PnL. The framework is working as designed.
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector gravity: in a rotation, even strong individual stocks get dragged by sector flows. The 3-day rule gives time to distinguish temporary rotation from regime change.
